info.title: modrelease
info.description: Release pipeline for BepInEx mods: clean build against the installed game, metadata verification, reproducible archive, GitHub release and a kit for posting to Nexus.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: machine with the game installed. Reads modrelease.json at the repository root.

commands.name: fingerprint
commands.description: Print the game fingerprint to record in modrelease.json

commands.name: package
commands.description:
Clean-build, package, verify and write the Nexus kit under artifacts/. Warns about anything
that would stop a release, but goes ahead, so the pipeline can be tried on any commit.

commands.name: release
commands.description:
The same, then create the GitHub release and upload the archive. Refuses unless the working
tree is clean, HEAD carries one pushed v* tag with a CHANGELOG section, and the game on disk
is the one in modrelease.json. Needs GITHUB_TOKEN in the environment: a fine-grained token
for the repository with Contents read and write (or a classic token with repo scope).

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: release: everything but the GitHub calls

options.name: --draft
options.description: release: create the GitHub release as a draft
